rows.en: Yeah, it's Zeta Gundam's weapon.
Yeah, that's gotta be the thing Zeta Gundam was lookin' for.
Yeah, that's gotta be the thing Zeta Gundam was lookin' for.
Yes. I think it's the weapon Zeta was looking for.
Yes, it's most likely the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
Yes, it's most likely the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
Yes, it's most likely the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
Yeah, it's probably the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
Yeah, that must be the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
Yes, it's most likely the weapon Zeta Gundam was looking for.
I see. Then I'll leave it with you all. Put it to good use in the battles ahead.
Obtained "Hyper Mega Launcher".
Well, I'll report it that way. Thanks!!
What are you doing? You're going to look for the weapon without Zeta Gundam?
Zeta Gundam must be in the party to progress this quest.
Completed the quest "Maganac's Request".
Word is an MS hunting Zeta Gundam has appeared in Desert Cube's Wasteland Zone. Investigate.
If it's that MS you're after... it should still be deep in the area up ahead.
There's something here!!
Well, well!! Found ya!! Zeta Gundam!! And you came strollin' right up to me on your own!!
So you're the one who's been looking for me!?
Thanks to you, I got run out of Regis Core and stuck in a dump like this, miserable and filthy!!
If I bring you back as a gift, my name's cleared!
All right, you lot! Seize Zeta Gundam!!
Fufufufu...
Hyahhaaa!!
You've even got underlings like these...!! I won't let you do as you please!!
This time it ain't gonna go like before!!
Dammit!! Retreat!!
Obtained Spider Silk.
Completed the quest "The Mysterious Mobile Suit".
You can report quests in the Quest Room at the base.
What!? You lot... Zeta Gundam ain't with you!?
Possible Psycommu weapon found in Desert Cube's Military Base. Check it with Nu & Zeta Gundam.
There was nothing inside.
...There's nothing in it.
This is the right place, though.
...Hm!? What is this feeling!!
I felt it too...
Let's go and see...
Right.
Nu Gundam and Zeta Gundam must be in the party to progress this quest.
This way.
It's not this way.
It's up ahead.
It's getting stronger, isn't it?
It's in here...!!
I'm opening it...!!
Ngh... Funnels!?
Where are they...!!
How did you know about this place!? You're Newtypes, aren't you!?
A Jagd Doga...!!
A survivor from the research facility!?
I'm not giving you the "Fin Funnels"!!
What!? ...So the Psycommu weapon was the "Fin Funnels"!!
Those belong to Nu Gundam!! We're taking them back!!
No way! These are really important to Regis!!
I don't have time to play with a child! Let's go!!
Go!! Funnels!!
Ahahahahah!! Go down, go down, go dooown!!!
This one's... a real pain.
All of you, just go dooown!!
Obtained "Fin Funnel".
We did it. With these, the fighting will get a lot easier.
Yeah... But it doesn't sit well with me that the enemy has even Newtypes under its command.
Completed the quest "Psycommu Weapon".
We got word from a comrade who's acting alone. Please head into Desert Cube's Military Base.
I've been waiting.
Altron!
Altron! What's going on?
Altron! What on earth happened?
Altron! What on earth happened?
Altron! What's going on?
Altron! Is something wrong?
Altron! What on earth happened?
Well, if it ain't Altron! What the hell happened?
Altron! What on earth happened?
Altron! What on earth happened?
Altron! Is something the matter?

notes.note: Quest004.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N-2) plays only 118 (+120, OkWin when Zeta is missing) and 120 (+122, completion) from this table's tail. 102-117 are unused: 102-111 finish the 13-slot no-Zeta leader block begun at 99 (quest_004), voiced from wording as quest_004 did (103/104 casual 'yatsu', 105 polite 'Zeta-san' -> 'Zeta'); identical Japanese kept identical (102 = 99-101).
113/115 = the unnamed casual client of the unused finale (115 identical to 79, kept identical). 117 speaker unknown (unused line addressed to a party without Zeta); kept neutral.

Quest005.bla (QuestEventMess005, same text) maps TextIdOffset+N to row N-1 here (verified: +20 Hambrabi -> 19, +21 Zeta -> 20, +25 Magma Dopant -> 24, +26 Ice Age Dopant -> 25). 8 = Maganac (CHARA_NAME 79).
Row 14 not referenced by Quest005.bla; treated as narration.
Hambrabi (CHARA_NAME 42, Yazan voice: thuggish) speaks 19, 21-23, 27, 29, 34; Zeta Gundam 20, 26; Magma Dopant 24; Ice Age Dopant 25. 'Noko-noko' = walking right in carelessly.
'Temiyage' (a gift to bring along) -> 'bring you back as a gift'; 'omei henjou' -> 'my name's cleared'.
Not referenced by the decompiled script (the GET sound plays before OkWin +32/+33 = rows 31/32); item name 'Spider Silk' from ItemNameFormal. Source has no brackets, so no quotes.
+35 -> row 34: Hambrabi line in the no-Zeta branch (Pt_Chara_Check(7)).
Compressed to fit the 2-line box: 'something that looks like' -> 'Possible', 'investigate' -> 'Check it'.
Header cell (like {F000} in other quest tables); kept as the digit.

Quest006.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N-3 (OkWin +10 -> 7 chest narration, +11 Nu -> 8, +12 Zeta -> 9 ... +57 Jagd Doga -> 54, +59 -> 56, +63 -> 60, +19 -> 16). Nu Gundam (Amuro): 8, 10, 12, 23, 29, 35, 39, 44, 47, 50; Zeta Gundam (Kamille, polite to Amuro, carried by tone): 9, 11, 13, 26, 30, 36, 40, 45, 48, 53.
Jagd Doga (CHARA_NAME 188) speaks 43, 46, 49, 51, 52, 54; childish female-coded speech, but glossary g=n, so no pronouns used; Nu calls it 'a child' (50).
'Research facility' not identified further in the source; kept literal.
'Ochiro' -> 'Go down', matching the story slices' rendering.
Rows 57/58 not referenced by the decompiled script; 57 polite -> Zeta Gundam, 58 -> Nu Gundam, inferred from wording.

Quest007.bla: +2 -> row 3 (??? = Altron, CHARA_NAME 30), +3 -> row 4 Wing Zero (required, script-fixed). 5-14 are unused leader variants voiced from wording, matching quest_006's inferred order (5 00, 6 God, 7 Zeta, 8 Nu, 9 OOO polite, 10 W, 11 Den-O rough, 12 RX, 13 Rider 1, 14 Mebius polite with -san dropped). 6/7/10/12/13 use quest_006's 'Altron! What on earth happened?' exactly.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest004-007.bla; offsets differ per script: Quest004 N-2, Quest005 N-1, Quest006 N-3, Quest007 N+1 (each checked against the empty rows and content). Unused rows voiced from wording: Q4 102-117, Q5 14/30, Q6 57-58, Q7 5-14. Q4 117 speaker unknown. New non-glossary names: none (Hambrabi, Magma Dopant, Ice Age Dopant, Jagd Doga, Regis Core, Spider Silk, Fin Funnel all from glossary/tables).
